title: say togtog na kapalandeyan no mansirunget la
intro: Dengel mo legan ya man-eecho iray lawak na panangidayew a kaiba so sakey a pinilin lingkor nen Allah. Say boses ya walaan na melodiya, sakey a panangukom ya aanapen na saray mansusuppiatan ed silir, tan metal ya pinalemew na madibinon ganggan so manaalagar ed pakadiskobre. Anton pigura na panagdayew tan matunong a pananguley so mansasalita panamegley na sarayan tanda?
clues: Siak so binendisyonan nen Allah na karakpan tan marakep a boses na panangidayew.
Imbangat ak nen Allah ya talosan so lenguahe na matunong a panangukom ed baetan na saray mansusuppiatan.
Inarap ko so sakey a mabiskeg a higanten mibabakal ed bakal tan diad linawa nen Allah et tinalo ko ra.
Naikdan ak na kakabatan, autoridad tan sakey a kasulatan na saray salmo manlapud si Allah.
Akaiba ak na saray palandey tan saray manok ya mangigloria ed si Allah a kaibak ed labi tan diad isabi na banwa.
Imbangat ak nen Allah ya manggawa na saray amerikana manlapud balatyang ya ginawan malambot parad siak.

Dhul-Kifl

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Tinalo toy Jalut (Goliath) ed bakal lapud linawa nen Allah
Nanggawa na Biong pian makaliktar ed baleg a delap
Nibantak ed apoy ya pinalemew nen Allah
Inakmon na baleg a sira ed dayat
Inmatagey ed tawen ya ag to natawayan so patey
trial.answer: Tinalo toy Jalut (Goliath) ed bakal lapud linawa nen Allah

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Saray palandey tan manok ya mankakasakey ed panangidayew ed si Allah
Sakey a baston ya nagmaliw ya uleg
Sakey ya apoy ya nagmaliw ya ambetel tan mareen
Sakey a kabatyan a kamelyo so imbaki bilang tanda ed totoo
Sakey a Kaban a gawad kiew ya akapeket ed Palandey Judi
location.answer: Saray palandey tan manok ya mankakasakey ed panangidayew ed si Allah

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Niiter so inkaari, kakabatan, tan say Zabur (Salmo)
Naikdan na anak a laki nen masiken la kayari na masimoon a pikakasi
Niiter so kaligenan ed ungib ed loob na dakel a taon
Niiter so subol na Zamzam ed desierto
Inmabobon ya nalner so armada ed dayat
outcome.answer: Niiter so inkaari, kakabatan, tan say Zabur (Salmo)

arabic: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verse: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise. (38:18)
